metaTitle: Custom Blue Luggage Accessories | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom blue luggage accessories for your team or event. Perfect Imprints offers tags, identifiers, and more in bulk.
introHtml: Blue luggage accessories help your team spot their bags quickly on the carousel or in a crowded hotel lobby. From durable luggage tags to bright grip identifiers, blue offers a professional yet distinctive look that stands out without being flashy. Whether you choose a classic navy or a vibrant royal blue, these accessories pair well with most luggage colors and are easy to decorate with your logo using screen printing or debossing. Perfect for corporate travel gifts, conference swag, or employee recognition.
heroAltText: Custom blue luggage accessories including luggage tags and identifiers for branding
